p5c1.caption: Threshold tablet — the book's fourth door
p5c1.fleuron_rationale: No fleurons: the chapter is a single 21-word spaced-title plate — a door, not a text.
p5c1.rationale: The chapter is one 21-word spaced-title plate ('D I S C I P L I N E A N D C U LT I VAT I O N') — a door, not a text. Sealing the ladder's steps inside an unbroken tablet says: rank and ascent exist here only as promise; the reader has not yet climbed. The star above the sealed steps is the legislator's star glimpsed before the doctrine.
p5c1.reading: Tablet only; the single para renders as the centered monument (no body column, no drop cap).
p5c1.title: Discipline and Cultivation

p5c2.caption: The doctrine of hierarchy — rank by quantities of power
p5c2.fleuron_rationale: after 4 (rank-definition aphorisms 0–4 close → long political argument at 5); after 8 (harsh-doctrine call → destruction triptych 9–11 + courage close).
p5c2.rationale: The chapter re-establishes hierarchy against 'suffrage universel' [0] with the load-bearing axiom 'Rank is determined and distinguished by quantities of power alone' [1]. Unequal tiers literalize the axiom: width IS power. The lone sulphur tick marks the rank worth holding.
p5c2.reading: Calm column; drop cap; 2 fleurons; no NB.
p5c2.title: Hierarchy — The Doctrine of Hierarchy

p5c3.caption: The strong and the weak — a 198-fragment braid
p5c3.fleuron_rationale: 19 authored movement boundaries (relief band after 112 serves as the 20th break; no fleuron stacked beside it): 8 close opening braid→tempo/mediocrity · 15 economics hinge→idealism · 23 machinery/superman→passions · 33 moderation→virtue-confusion · 43 rulers/egoism→tyrannizing/Napoleon · 54 value-of-man→hierarchy core · 67 →'hierarchy of human values' plate at 68 · 78 herd/solitary→virtue-economics · 87 →mediocrity block · 95 →enhancement/strong-to-come · 120 Sils-Maria colophon→digestion · 126 →eight questions · 134 →disciples/schooling · 145 →Church-abuse catalogue · 153 death→feeling-stronger close of that braid · 163 solitude→value-theory · 169 →Napoleon/Beethoven suffering · 179 →passion-mastery run · 192 →finale (amazing/finest close unbroken).
p5c3.rationale: The book's longest chapter (198 paras) braids the mass/strength dialectic: weak-triumph [3], machinery and the superman [17–18], future European [23], lordly types incl. 'the legislator' [110], the four-book plan naming Book IV 'the hammer' [113–120], strict schooling [138–140], NB against Mill [175], mastery of the passions [186]. Converging/diverging rails hold both types 'viewed from above' [74] without reconciling them — exactly the chapter's demand that 'the gulf between them [be] widened'.
p5c3.reading: Calm column throughout; 19 fleurons; 3 .reader-nb treatments; relief band after [112] (before 'The Will to Power' title plate at 113): full-width gouged ascent fragment framing the four-book plan as the chapter's keystone.

relief.index_rationale: After 112 ('An insight lacking among free-thinkers…' — discipline that strengthens the strong and breaks the mediocre) and before the 'The Will to Power / An attempt at a revaluation / In four books' title plate at 113–115: the band frames the four-book plan as the chapter's keystone.

p5c3.title: The Strong and the Weak

p5c4.caption: The noble man — thou-shalt, I-will, I-am
p5c4.fleuron_rationale: after 2 (abundance thesis→equality-psychology) · 6 (diminish-catalogue→Thierry history) · 9+12 (frame the Greek ascent triptych 10–12 as an exhibit) · 18 (blood hinge→'What is noble?' catalogue) · 34 (To-catalogue→We-voice) · 38 (We-voice→second noble-braid) · 48 (swords→superabundance finale).
p5c4.rationale: Nobility-as-abundance [0] climbs an explicit three-rung ladder — 'Higher than thou shalt stands I will; higher than I will stands I am' [11] — past the eagle's direct strike [46] and 'Paradise under the shadow of swords' [48] toward a superabundance that outlives the virtues [49]. Chevrons ascend; the strike diagonal refuses symmetry, as nobility refuses the rule.
p5c4.reading: Calm column; drop cap; 8 fleurons; To-catalogue (19–34) and finale (49–54) run unbroken inside their frames.
p5c4.title: The Noble Man

p5c5.caption: The lords of the earth — the opposite type, deliberately cultivated
p5c5.fleuron_rationale: after 5 (grazing-morality/antiquity argument closes → 'I write for a breed of men that does not yet exist' declaration at 6). Single break for a 12-fragment chapter.
p5c5.rationale: The wicked whispered question [0] proposes 'the essentially artificial and deliberate cultivation of the opposite type' as redemption of democracy, asked against 'how shall the earth be governed as a whole?' [3] and answered by international kinship groups rearing 'the lords of the earth' [10]. Two ladders (herd/herders) joined by one hot rung: nature doubled, artifice joining.
p5c5.reading: Calm column; the 543-word fragment [4] and 189-word [3] get strict measure discipline (34–38rem) — no art near them; 1 fleuron; no NB.
p5c5.title: The Lords of the Earth

p5c6.caption: The great man — a building in the grand style
p5c6.fleuron_rationale: after 6 (bow/passion/power braid 0–6 → instincts-synthesis at 7); after 10 (great-men-are-evil braid → cost/heredity at 11).
p5c6.rationale: Greatness is architecture under tension: moralities 'draw the bow, provided they do not break it' [0]; the great man follows 'a long-term plan' [1] with 'an enlarged sense of himself as causa and voluntas' [4], costs 'capital accumulation' across ancestry [11], and ends bearing destinies [14]. The edifice stacks cost into form; the bent rail holds the bow's tension.
p5c6.reading: Calm column; drop cap; 2 fleurons; NB. margin-bar + marker on [1]; long paras [1,13,14] disciplined measure.
p5c6.title: The Great Man

p5c7.caption: The legislator of the future — thus shall it be
p5c7.fleuron_rationale: after 2 (two-kinds→human horizon) · 10 (preconditions catalogue→royal calling) · 19 (rulers'-virtues→solitude) · 27 (estrangement/eagles→serene philosophers) · 33 (heights/above-below→strength-acquisition + unbroken finale 34–44: prophecy, superman, Dante).
p5c7.rationale: Two philosopher kinds split the chapter open — summarizers vs 'legislators of value judgements' who command 'Thus shall it be!' [0–1] — then ascend through Caesar/Napoleon sculptor-disinterestedness [5], the five preconditions [6–10], Alcuin's royal calling [11], solitude 'amid clouds and lightning' [31], estrangement-chasms [26], to 'Not mankind, but the superman is the goal!' [43] and Dante's eternity-line [44]. The ladder outruns its rungs: legislation exceeds preparation.
p5c7.reading: Calm column; drop cap; 5 fleurons; finale run 34–44 unbroken (strength→prophecy→superman→Dante); no NB.
p5c7.title: The Highest Man as Legislator of the Future

p5c8.caption: Discipline as selective life — the bird's-eye view
p5c8.fleuron_rationale: 17 authored boundaries (relief band after 68 serves as the 18th break; no fleuron stacked beside it — 68 REMOVED from the designer's 18-entry list per binding refinement): 8 dedication+bird's-eye→1876 crisis · 12 curse-dichotomy→revaluation · 16 points-of-view keystone→new-world braid · 25 strength-sketch→19th century · 29 modernity→smallest-world · 37 Dante/Michelangelo/Napoleon hinge→religion · 41 pessimism-of-strength→pessimism catalogue · 48 catalogue→Dionysian denial + Five No's · 54 No's→abundance · 59 rank/grand-style→culture/evil · 76 soul-circumference→affirmative catalogue · 88 gratitude→pagans/Olympus · 96 god-braid→Art preface · 105 theses-maxims→equals/discipline · 114 sensual→senses list · 119 instincts→eternity/will close · 127 poetry/lyric→closing Dionysus braid (128–132 unbroken).
p5c8.rationale: Discipline here is selective life: the well-constituted dedication (carved wood [0]), the principle of selectivity [5], the bird's-eye view [8], points of view for values [16], the strong-man sketch [25], the pessimism-of-strength [40], Five No's [50–54], the affirmative-emotions catalogue [77–88], pagans of Olympus [90], and the closing Dionysus-vs-Crucified contrast [130–132]. Widening arcs that shed steps: ascent by exclusion.
p5c8.reading: Calm column; drop cap; 17 fleurons + relief band after [68] (midpoint hinge evil-braid → ascending turn); NB. on [92]; the 1-word catalogue paras (78–80, 83, 85) and 519-word [128] both disciplined by measure, never by color.

relief.index_rationale: AUTHORED (binding refinement, designer-accepted): after 68 ('Evil, in this respect, means hard, painful, oppressive.' — the evil-braid closes at 66–68) and before 69 ('Men such as Napoleon must come again and again…' — the ascending turn toward beast/super-beast [70], soul-circumference [75], affirmative catalogue [77–88]). Midpoint hinge of the chapter; no fleuron stacked beside it.

p5c8.title: Discipline and Cultivation

p5c9.caption: The closing hammer — eternal recurrence, the monster of energy

end_seal.method: use-clone: supervisor script appends <svg class='crown-seal' aria-hidden='true'><use href='art/crown.svg#crown-seal'/></svg> inside the last paragraph (A.0: ≤32px, no layout shift, no bare glyph). No extra asset file; the seal lives in the sprite.

p5c9.fleuron_rationale: after 3 (hammer braid→prophecy plate at 4) · 10 (doctrine outline→greatest danger) · 18 (selection/means→physics run) · 24 (emperor-eternity hinge→world-conception) · 30 (cycle proof→mirror close at 31; finale para 31 + seal unbroken).
p5c9.rationale: The book closes as prophecy: the great cultivating idea [0,3], the hammer as new weapon [1] and ecstatic-nihilist press [2], 'Eternal Recurrence. A book of prophecy.' [4] with its numbered plan [5–10], the oligarchy of greatest danger [11], recurrence-as-selection [12–15], the physics of force without equilibrium [19–23], the emperor's eternity [24], and the mirror held up to 'a monster of energy' [31]. Downward wedge + starburst: the ladder's last step is struck, not climbed.
p5c9.reading: Calm column; drop cap; 5 fleurons; numbered outline paras (5–10, 13–15) quiet indent (Book IV: no green tick — that is Book III's); monster paras [19, 28, 31] disciplined measure; end-seal.
p5c9.title: Discipline and Cultivation

Thousands separators in the CSS-rendered form are the supervisor's formatting choice at mirror time (pre-formatted strings mirrored verbatim are acceptable).
